title: Non-Hermitian free-fermion critical systems and logarithmic conformal field theory
abstract: Asks whether a 1+1D gapless non-Hermitian system admits a conformal description, for a PT-symmetric free-fermion field theory. In the biorthogonal formalism, constructs a traceless energy-momentum tensor whose Fourier modes generate a Virasoro algebra with c=-2: a non-Hermitian biorthogonal realization of a logarithmic CFT with staggered Virasoro modules and universal indecomposability parameters. A microscopic lattice construction at exceptional-point criticality reproduces the same conformal data with finite-size corrections. v1 2026-02-02, v2 2026-04-06.
key_claims: Biorthogonal Koo-Saleur lattice Fourier modes (their Eq. 25/S68, citing Koo-Saleur 1994 and Milsted-Vidal 2017) carry a negative true central charge c=-2 on a PT-symmetric critical chain

c is read from the central term of [L_m, L_n], derived analytically in the scaling limit (free-fermion model), not fitted; fitted lattice quantities are the indecomposability parameters beta_1, beta_2 with (2pi/N)^2 corrections
Works AT the exceptional point (log-CFT), whereas our SIM-2026-071 works deliberately away from it at the Yang-Lee M(2,5) point
